components.name: Opus
components.patentNotices: Patent declarations are retained verbatim in COPYING; see its IETF references.
components.modificationNotice: The opusic-sys upstream vendor applies opus.patch to CMake runtime and OSCE build definitions. Oink makes no further Opus source changes; the patch is preserved with the native terms.

components.name: WebRTC audio processing (AEC3 subset)
components.patentNotices: The WebRTC additional patent grant is retained verbatim in PATENTS.
components.modificationNotice: Vendored as oink-aec3 (crates/oink-audio/native/aec3): AEC3 only, fixed stereo, namespace and symbol isolation, and realtime-storage.patch; its NOTICE lists every change. Includes the Takuya Ooura FFT under its own permission notice. The source integrity is vendor-manifest.json, which pins every vendored file.

components.name: WixToolset.Firewall.wixext custom actions
components.compatibilityReview: The MSI embeds unmodified native firewall custom actions from the WiX extension as separate installer files; these do not link Oink GPL code. This is an aggregate distribution, not relicensing MS-RL code to GPL. Preserve MS-RL and attribution; provide the complete corresponding WiX source at the pinned upstream commit with release source materials, including any changes if modified. No global MS-RL allowance is granted to application dependencies.

components.name: WixToolset.UI.wixext installer UI
components.compatibilityReview: The MSI embeds unmodified dialog resources and native custom actions from the WiX UI extension as separate installer files; these do not link Oink GPL code. This is an aggregate distribution, not relicensing MS-RL code to GPL. Preserve MS-RL and attribution; provide the complete corresponding WiX source at the pinned upstream commit with release source materials, including any changes if modified. No global MS-RL allowance is granted to application dependencies.

components.name: libASPL
components.compatibilityReview: Recovered pinned HAL dependency. MIT plus Apple sample-code AML grant redistribution with retained notices; retain all three upstream license texts in the driver and package. HAL component only.

components.name: VB-CABLE
components.linkage: Separate optional OS driver, unchanged archive; no code linked into Oink
components.compatibilityReview: Standard package only, published vendor distribution permission; attribution and donation link shown before explicit installation. See distribution notice for professional-license conditions and older readme wording.

assets.name: Lucide fold-horizontal icon (adapted)

assets.name: Lucide icons
assets.modificationNotice: The mobile apps convert the lucide-react icons used by the Oink mobile design into vector path data (Android) and PDF image assets (iOS); shapes unchanged.

assets.name: Android™ robot head (adapted)
assets.modificationNotice: Shapes unchanged; drawn in the official file's #34A853 with the eyes in the background colour as a knockout; the privileged-mode badge adds a gold crown above the head (Oink addition).
copyright: The Android robot is reproduced or modified from work created and shared by Google and used according to terms described in the Creative Commons 3.0 Attribution License.

assets.compatibilityReview: Brand artwork drawn as a separate visual asset in the device badge, not code combined with Oink GPL sources. CC BY 3.0 permits adapted redistribution with attribution, the license reference and a modification notice, all kept in this entry; the trademark notice is retained.

assetPolicy: No third-party font files are currently checked into the product sources. npm icon/asset libraries are recorded by the npm inventory.
